description: This file contains a CMake script defining a function 'compile_aidl' used for generating source code from AIDL files during build time. It configures the aidl compiler, processes parameters, and executes the command to generate language-specific source files.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function for compiling AIDL files into source code, handling parameters for compiler location, flags, language, include directories, and output directories, then executing the aidl compiler accordingly.
